title: 第28章 你怎么知道这个是高僧圆寂的木鱼？
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
楚星尘回到自家宗门小院时，大小徒弟还未购物回来。

    也不知道自家大弟子跑哪里进货去了，这么久了还没回来。

    不过此刻最为重要的灵石问题安排交给了老熟人瑶琴。

    目前最重要的事情也算安排清楚了，这是自己来渝州城最为主要的目的。

    想来能顺利解决的概率还是蛮大的。

    毕竟根据楚星尘的推测，整个竹玉庭本身应该是和一个修仙门派挂钩。

    自己最初遇见瑶琴时她便是金丹修为。

    金丹修为，在这偏僻之地都能称作老祖，享长老位置。

    在这竹玉庭却还是在弹琴。

    这种配置……甚至大概率是中州门派的宗门。

    所以对于瑶琴能否解决这件事，楚星尘还是蛮有信心。

    毕竟此刻空间戒指之中的灵石全是这种血气灵石。

    这要是拿出去当钱花，妥妥要被正道人士当场做掉的。

    更何况，这种血气灵石除了邪修以外，谁都不收。

    现在的楚星尘看似十分富有，实际上却连一块能用的灵石都掏不出来。

    钱有，但不能花。

    楚星尘将出门前设置的小阵法收回。

    走进徒弟主动给自己留下的正房。

    楚星尘目光扫过房间，确实收拾的还算干净，房间内也有桌椅板凳，坐在椅子上，楚星尘拿出那一枚血气灵石开始研究。

    自己如今好歹也算是无暇金丹，还是有这个资格研究一下的。

    不过这一研究，楚星尘才越发觉这灵石是真邪性。

    血气居然和灵石内的灵气居然有融合倾向。

    这……从某种意义上来说，属实是有点厉害的。

    灵石是灵气跟着灵脉腾挪时，由于灵气密度极高，长时间互相吸引粘接，团聚成型。

    这过程中，灵气会逐渐稳定，不再容纳灵气以外的东西。

    灵气完成成为灵石之后这种属性会更为突出。

    所以说，对灵石动这种手脚其实是一种技巧活。
content_en:
When Chu Xingchen returned to his sect's courtyard, his disciples had not yet returned from shopping.

    I don’t know where my eldest disciple went to buy goods, and he hasn’t come back after so long.

    However, the most important issue of spiritual stones at this moment was left to an old acquaintance, Yao Qin.

    At present, the most important things have been arranged clearly. This is the main purpose of coming to Yuzhou City.

    Thinking about it, the probability that it can be solved smoothly is quite high.

    After all, according to Chu Xingchen's speculation, the entire Bamboo Yuting Court itself should be linked to a sect of cultivating immortals.

    When he first met Yaoqin, she was a golden elixir cultivator.

    With Jindan cultivation, one can be called an ancestor in this remote place and enjoy the position of elder.

    In this bamboo jade garden, I am still playing the piano.

    This configuration... is even very likely to be that of the Zhongzhou sect.

    So Chu Xingchen was quite confident whether Yao Qin could solve this matter.

    After all, the spiritual stones in the space ring at this moment are all this kind of blood spiritual stones.

    If this was used as money, it would be done on the spot by a righteous person.

    What's more, no one except evil cultivators will accept this blood spirit stone.

    Chu Xingchen seems to be very rich now, but in fact he can't even afford a single useful spiritual stone.

    I have money, but I can’t spend it.

    Chu Xingchen took back the small formation he set up before going out.

    He walked into the main room that his apprentice took the initiative to leave for him.

    Chu Xingchen glanced at the room. It was indeed clean. There were tables, chairs and benches in the room. Sitting on the chair, Chu Xingchen took out the blood spirit stone and began to study it.

    Now that I can be considered a flawless golden elixir, I still have the qualifications to study it.

    However, through this research, Chu Xingchen realized more and more that this spirit stone was of true evil nature.

    The blood energy actually has a tendency to fuse with the spiritual energy in the spirit stone.

    This... in a sense, is actually a bit powerful.

    Spiritual stones are formed when the spiritual energy moves along with the spiritual veins. Due to the extremely high density of the spiritual energy, they attract and bond with each other for a long time, and then reunite and form.

    During this process, the aura will gradually stabilize and no longer contain anything other than the aura.

    This attribute will be more prominent after the spiritual energy is completed and turned into spiritual stones.

    Therefore, doing this to the spirit stone is actually a kind of skill.
title_en: Chapter 28 How do you know this is the wooden fish of the eminent monk who passed away?
